title: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand Tour Package from India
highlights: Discover the best of Southeast Asia with our Singapore Malaysia Indonesia and Thailand Tour, offering a perfect blend of city life, stunning beaches & cultural experiences.
Embark on a Coral Island Tour in Pattaya, where you can relax on pristine beaches, enjoy thrilling water sports, and explore vibrant marine life.
Feel the thrill of the Jungle Swing, soaring over lush forests and rice terraces, while enjoying stunning views of Bali’s tropical beauty.
Explore the ancient Batu Caves, featuring a 140-foot statue of Lord Murugan and limestone caves believed to be over 400 million years old.
Stroll through Gardens by the Bay, featuring the futuristic Supertree Grove and the Flower Dome, a vibrant paradise of exotic plants and colorful floral displays.
overview:
About the Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand Tour Package from India:
The Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand Tour Package from India offers an incredible opportunity to explore the best of Southeast Asia. Starting with the vibrant city of Bangkok, this journey takes you to the coastal charm of Pattaya, where you’ll visit the famous Coral Island. In Singapore, enjoy the iconic Marina Bay Sands, the stunning Gardens by the Bay, and a city tour filled with architectural marvels. Kuala Lumpur brings a mix of cultural and natural beauty, with visits to the Batu Caves and Genting Highlands. Finally, in Bali, experience the serene Kintamani Highlands, the famous Bali Swing, and the beautiful Tegenungan Waterfall.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya | Leisure Day
days.desc: Begin your Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand tour package from India as you board your flight from Delhi. Upon arrival in Bangkok, get driven to Pattaya and check into your hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can visit the Art in Paradise Museum, housing an interactive 3D art gallery or the Sanctuary of Truth, a wooden structure dedicated to philosophy and art. You can also relax at Jomtien Beach & capture stunning sunset views. Later, return to the hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Coral Island
days.desc: Today, you'll be driven to Bali Hai Pier for a speedboat ride to Coral Island, known for its scenic beaches and crystal-clear waters. Famous for its vibrant marine ecosystem, this tropical getaway offers thrilling water sports such as jet skiing, parasailing, and snorkeling (available at an additional cost), allowing you to explore its underwater wonders. Visit Tawaen Beach, where you can relax under beach umbrellas or savor a delicious beachfront meal. Later, you'll be driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Fly to Singapore | Visit to Night Safari
days.desc: Post checkout, you'll be transferred to the airport and board your flight to Singapore. Upon arrival, get driven to your hotel, check in and relax. In the evening get driven to the Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park. Begin with a tram ride that takes you through six zones. Witness species like binturongs, fishing cats, and civets in action under moonlight. Stroll along walking trails such as the Fishing Cat Trail for closer encounters. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Visit to Marina Bay Sands & Garden by the Bay
days.desc: Today, you'll be driven to visit the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, where you can take in stunning views of the Singapore skyline from its 57th-floor observation deck. Next, explore Gardens by the Bay, a futuristic nature park. Wander through the Cloud Forest, home to the world's tallest indoor waterfall & the Flower Dome, showcasing an impressive variety of global flora. The unique Supertree Grove, with its towering tree-like structures, is another must-see. Afterward, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Begin your day by getting driven to the Universal Studios, a theme park offering a mix of thrilling rides, immersive experiences, and live entertainment spread across seven themed zones. Dive into thrilling adventures with roller coasters and attractions based on your favorite movies, from the world of Jurassic Park to the glitzy streets of Hollywood. Explore interactive shows, get up close with famous movie characters, and enjoy lively street performances. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Singapore City Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to explore Singapore. Visit various sites such as the Civilian War Memorial, Esplanade Theaters and the Singapore Art Museum, which houses a vast collection of Southeast Asian art. Stroll through the famous Merlion Park and marvel at the Helix Bridge, a modern architectural wonder. Admire other architectural marvels such as Singapore Flyer and the Marina Bay Sands. End your tour at Chinatown, filled with lively markets and cultural sites before being driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Kuala Lumpur | Kuala Lumpur City Tour
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Kuala Lumpur. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and later, embark on a city tour, starting with a visit to the Istana Negara, Malaysia's official royal palace. Then, admire the National Mosque & continue to the Tugu Negara, Malaysia's national monument, and the historical Sultan Abdul Samad Building. End your tour with a visit to the KL Tower, offering panoramic views of the city’s skyline. Afterward, get driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Visit to Batu Caves & Genting Highlands
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Genting Highlands. On the way, stop at Batu Caves, renowned for its colorful temples, stunning limestone caves and the golden statue of Lord Murugan. Continue your journey to the Awana SkyWay Cable Car station and enjoy panoramic views of a 100-million-year-old rainforest. Once you reach the summit, explore the Genting Highlands Resort, famous for its world-class casinos, diverse dining options & exciting roller coaster rides. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Fly to Ubud | Leisure Day
days.desc: Today, check out and get driven to the airport for your flight to Bali. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel in Ubud. After checking in, enjoy the day at leisure. You can visit the sacred Tirta Empul Temple, known for its holy spring waters used in purification rituals. You can also shop handcrafted souvenirs and local arts at the Ubud Art Market or explore Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave), a historic site known for its intricate carvings. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven for a Bali sightseeing tour, starting with a visit to the Kintamani village, where you'll be treated to panoramic views of the active Mount Batur volcano. Next, explore the Tegalalang Rice Terraces, renowned for their lush greenery and intricate patterns. Feel the adrenaline rush as you experience the Bali Swing, soaring high above the jungle canopy for stunning views. Conclude your tour with a visit to Tegenungan Waterfall & later, get driven back to the hotel.
